US Launches Cybercrime Center With TRM Labs to Track Crypto Scams
Task Force Launches Threat Disruption Center With TRM Labs Software

bullets: Own the vision, strategy and outcomes of a strategically important product area.
Identify emerging market opportunities and develop conviction around where TRM should invest.
Lead zero-to-one product development and scale existing products into new markets and use cases.
Shape how AI and emerging technologies can fundamentally transform customer workflows and outcomes.
Build deep relationships with customers and industry leaders to anticipate needs before they become obvious.
Own the end-to-end product lifecycle, from customer discovery and strategy through launch, adoption and iteration.
Develop a deep understanding of customer workflows, unmet needs and emerging market opportunities.
Translate complex technical and customer problems into intuitive, differentiated product experiences.
Identify opportunities to leverage AI and emerging technologies to fundamentally improve customer outcomes.
Partner with Engineering, Design, Data Science and Intelligence to deliver high-impact solutions at speed.
Prevent financial crime in real time: Detect suspicious activity and illicit financial flows before funds disappear or customers become victims.
Safely launch new financial products: Enable institutions to confidently introduce stablecoin payments, digital asset custody and blockchain-enabled financial services.
Unify financial intelligence: Connect traditional financial data with blockchain intelligence to deliver a comprehensive understanding of financial risk.
Transform investigations with AI: Automate complex investigative workflows, uncover hidden connections and accelerate decision-making.
Modernize financial crime infrastructure: Replace fragmented, manual workflows with intelligent, scalable and integrated technology.
Leading: Hire, coach, and develop PMs. Give direct feedback, know each PM's growth areas, and step in early when a PM or project starts to slip.
Setting direction: Set the vision for onchain compliance and prioritize across your PMs. Define success and failure with real metrics.
Staying hands-on: Own a few critical initiatives yourself. Prototype, build AI agents, and ship alongside your team.
Closing: Build ongoing customer relationships and join strategic deals. Turn what you hear into roadmap unlocks.
Reporting and risk: Tell leadership how Onchain Compliance is doing, using real metrics. Call out risks early and unblock PMs before projects fail.
